# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph and Vulkan reliability**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp 4.159.0 update hardens glyph rendering and handles specific Vulkan allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts** — Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph rather than stale initial state when successive loads disagree about paths, formats or bounds. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and clipped embossed masks use full plane strides for correct copying. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Avoid driver failures after Vulkan allocation errors** — On Imagination drivers, Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory, because destroying those pools can trigger a driver failure. Graphite also stops allocating through the abandoned handle. The workaround applies only to that vendor and those errors. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
